verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no-code automation: you describe a process once in natural language and Lindy saves it as a skill [lindy-docs-18, lindy-docs-6], and routines run a whole recurring job from a schedule or trigger [lindy-docs-19]. That is conversational, not a visual editor. Missing for 10: any evidence of a visual or drag-and-drop workflow editor, explicit construction of multi-step flows with branching or ordered steps, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
